title: Temperature Trend Persistence
scenario: Identify cities where the daily average temperature has been increasing for 5 consecutive days.
tableSchema: weather_data (city_name VARCHAR, reading_date DATE, temp_c NUMERIC)
hint: LAG(temp) vs temp, create groups, count streak.
correctQuery: SELECT city_name FROM (SELECT city_name, COUNT(*) as streak FROM (SELECT city_name, reading_date, (reading_date - ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY city_name ORDER BY reading_date)::INT) as grp FROM (SELECT city_name, reading_date, temp_c, LAG(temp_c) OVER(PARTITION BY city_name ORDER BY reading_date) as prev_temp FROM weather_data) t WHERE temp_c > prev_temp) t2 GROUP BY city_name, grp) t3 WHERE streak >= 5;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE weather_data (city_name VARCHAR, reading_date DATE, temp_c NUMERIC);
